src: The resected tumour was an invasive non-mucinous adenocarcinoma, acinar predominant, with a minor micropapillary component and visceral pleural invasion.
Minimally invasive adenocarcinoma is a lepidic-predominant tumour of 3 cm or less with no more than 5 mm of invasion.
must: carcinom tuyến xâm lấn tối thiểu

src: The tumour cells were positive for TTF-1 and napsin A and negative for p40, consistent with lung adenocarcinoma.
Squamous cell carcinoma and small cell lung carcinoma are strongly associated with smoking, whereas non-small cell lung carcinoma in never-smokers is usually adenocarcinoma.
must: carcinom phổi không tế bào nhỏ

src: Spread through air spaces (STAS) was identified beyond the edge of the main tumour.
The PD-L1 tumour proportion score was 60%, and sequencing detected an EGFR exon 19 deletion; no ALK rearrangement was found.
The surgical lung biopsy showed a usual interstitial pneumonia pattern with fibroblastic foci and honeycombing.
must_not: viêm phổi mô kẽ thông thường

src: EBUS-TBNA of a mediastinal lymph node showed non-necrotizing granulomas favouring sarcoidosis; no acid-fast bacilli were identified.
Pleural effusion cytology with a cell block supported epithelioid malignant mesothelioma with BAP1 loss.
At autopsy the lungs showed diffuse alveolar damage with hyaline membranes and type II pneumocyte hyperplasia.
must: tổn thương phế nang lan tỏa
